results.description:
Oliver has always been the quiet one.

Lark has never been quiet a day in her life.

Tasked with keeping her safe while the Northbound Reapers continue circling the Fallen Lords, Oliver is determined to keep things professional. Lark has other plans. She isn't about to let one stubborn biker keep pretending he doesn't feel the same pull she does.

As danger closes in and old insecurities refuse to stay buried, Oliver will have to decide if protecting Lark means keeping his distance or finally admitting she's the missing piece he's been searching for all along.
